{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Trial of Thunder.png |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Toh Yahsa|???]] |location= Thundra Plateau |prereq= |reward= [[Toh Yahsa Shrine]] |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Trial of Thunder||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Trial of Thunder}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|Thundra Plateau}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== When [[Link]] reaches the vicinity of the [[Thundra Plateau]], he will hear the voice of [[Toh Yahsa]], who offers him a trial.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|You who have reached this land of thunder, I present you with a trial.}}|Toh Yahsa|BotW}} He is instructed to return the "four spirits" to their proper places, which will reveal an [[Ancient Shrine]] to him.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|When the four spirits have been settled in their proper places, they will guide you to the hero's trial.}}|Toh Yahsa|BotW}} After hearing this, the [[Shrine Quest]] will begin. The Thundra Plateau is constantly subjected to a [[Thunderstorm]]. Around Plateau are four orbs of different colors, which Link must retrieve. The purple sphere sits near the north pillar on the ground. In addition, the green sphere sits atop the southern pillar. The red sphere is located on top of a stone statue east of the Plateau, while the orange sphere is atop a taller stone statue directly north of the plateau. Link can climb up to the spheres or knock them down using [[Stasis]] and [[Arrow]]s. By using Stasis, Link can knock the spheres up onto the Plateau with [[Weapon]]s or [[Remote Bomb]]s. After gathering all four spheres on the Thundra Plateau, Link can place them in the basins below their matching pillars.{{Cite|You set the four spirit in their proper places based on the diagrams on the stone pillars.|Adventure Log|BotW}} The purple spheres goes in the northern basin, the red sphere goes in the eastern basin, the green sphere goes in the southern basin, and the orange sphere goes in the western basin. Once all of the orbs have been matched, [[Toh Yahsa Shrine]] will emerge from the ground in the middle of the Plateau.{{Cite|When this was done, a shrine appeared in the middle on the Thundra Plateau!|Adventure Log|BotW}} With this, the Shrine Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | When you arrived at the Thundra Plateau, a fierce storm blowing around you, a voice spoke.

The voice said that a trial would appear once four spirits were set in their proper places. |- | Complete | You set the four spirits in their proper places based on the diagrams on the stone pillars.
